video_title: Hornets at Clippers: Christian Anderson Jr. Postgame Media Availability | 11/15/2026

quotes.speaker: Christian Anderson Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Christian Anderson Jr. on his offensive development and confidence
quotes.excerpt: I think just getting more comfortable in what positions I need to be in and just getting more confident
quotes.quote: I think just getting more comfortable in what positions I need to be in and just getting more confident and being more ready to tag, be aggressive, whether it's score the ball or facilitate. Then again, like I said, I think it's just putting myself in the right position to succeed.
quotes.social_post: Christian Anderson Jr. on his recent growth: I think just getting more comfortable in what positions I need to be in and just getting more confident and being more ready to tag, be aggressive, whether it is score the ball or facilitate.

structured.context: Christian Anderson Jr. discusses his personal offensive development and growing confidence during his postgame media availability.

quotes.speaker: Christian Anderson Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Christian Anderson Jr. on defensive expectations and team identity
quotes.excerpt: they put a big importance on being able to guard the ball and be physical and be disruptive
quotes.quote: From the beginning, when I got drafted here, they put a big importance on being able to guard the ball and be physical and be disruptive. Try to create extra possessions for our team and make it as hard as I can to make it as hard for them to score. So, yeah, I've put in a lot of work and put a lot of emphasis on just guarding the ball and being aggressive on that end of the floor.
quotes.social_post: Christian Anderson Jr. on the Hornets defensive identity: From the beginning, they put a big importance on being able to guard the ball and be physical and be disruptive.

structured.context: Christian Anderson Jr. explains the defensive expectations and identity established by the team since he was drafted.

quotes.speaker: Christian Anderson Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Christian Anderson Jr. on the Clippers' late-game execution
quotes.excerpt: They hit some tough shots and we didn't hit shots. I think that's where we got to be better
quotes.quote: They hit some tough shots and we didn't hit shots. I think that's where we got to be better, just being able to dictate where we want to force the defense and how we want to stop them. But yeah, I think it just shifted when they started to hit shots at the end.
quotes.social_post: Christian Anderson Jr. on the late game loss to the Clippers: They hit some tough shots and we did not hit shots. I think that is where we got to be better, just being able to dictate where we want to force the defense.

structured.context: Christian Anderson Jr. reflects on the late-game execution and the Clippers' ability to hit shots during the final minutes.

quotes.speaker: Christian Anderson Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Christian Anderson Jr. on defensive strategy and personnel
quotes.excerpt: trying to make the right guys shoot and playing tendencies and playing personnel
quotes.quote: Trying to make the right guys shoot and playing tendencies and playing personnel, not letting their go-to guys get open shots or good looks, making it as hard as possible as it is for them to get shots and executing on the offensive end.
quotes.social_post: Christian Anderson Jr. on defensive strategy: Trying to make the right guys shoot and playing tendencies and playing personnel, not letting their go to guys get open shots or good looks.

structured.context: Christian Anderson Jr. describes the defensive strategy of focusing on opponent personnel and tendencies during the game.
